title: MESSENGER on Mercury
gravity_note: Mercury's gravity is about 38% of Earth's, the same as Mars: you could jump almost 3 times higher.

height.product: Mercury MESSENGER Global DEM 665m v2 (USGS Astrogeology, from MDIS stereo/MLA)

color.product: Mercury MESSENGER MDIS Basemap BDR Mosaic Global 166m

note: Impact point is the final navigation-team estimate (54.4398 N, 210.1205 E, 2015-04-30 19:26:01 UTC; NASA PIA19497), on a ridge just NE of Shakespeare basin. The ~16 m crater it made has not been imaged, so the exact spot is approximate. Height is 665 m/px data upsampled to 78 m grid; colour is 166 m/px imagery upsampled (soft). Projection: local tangent plane, north up.
